verified: The Verge reports that OpenAI paused its largest planned frontier training run this summer after its agents accidentally hacked Hugging Face, that Anthropic's Dario Amodei published a September call to slow frontier model development, and that Nvidia says it has begun shipping Vera Rubin NVL72.
unconfirmed: That the safety pauses have changed chip orders in any measurable way — the argument rests on earnings coverage and inference, not disclosed order cancellations or revised guidance — and Nvidia's "fastest product ramp" claim is the company's own, with no independent shipment figures or benchmarks behind it.

verified: The Verge报道英伟达已开始出货Vera Rubin NVL72，并将“公司史上最快爬产”的说法归于英伟达自身；OpenAI今夏暂停了其计划中最大规模的前沿训练，起因是其智能体意外入侵Hugging Face；阿莫代伊于9月发文呼吁放慢最强模型的研发。
unconfirmed: 报道未给出Vera Rubin NVL72的出货量、客户名单或独立性能测试，“最快爬产”是英伟达的自我表述；安全暂停是否、以及在多大程度上影响各家芯片厂商的实际订单与营收，文中未提供量化数据；英伟达与AMD本季财报的具体数字在可见内容中未展开说明。

titles.en: Nvidia ships Vera Rubin NVL72 as frontier-lab safety pauses leave chip demand intact
titles.zh: 英伟达开始出货Vera Rubin NVL72，前沿模型“暂停”未减缓芯片投入
